interpretationRules: No drift threshold is a Production threshold in v0.
Same-source pixel transforms may evaluate image-condition sensitivity but do not substitute for real head-pose or expression pairs.
Head yaw, pitch, roll, and expression require a real same-subject pair or controlled 3D same-identity pair; 2D warps must not be labeled as those nuisances.
Same dimension IDs across providers do not establish provider-anchor equivalence.
chin_height_ratio and nose_width_ratio remain cross-provider HOLD under the current semantic contract.
Other cross-provider dimensions remain unvalidated unless the semantic contract is explicitly promoted by separate evidence.
Canonical model comparison is diagnostic only and is not same-subject evidence.
No biometric identity matching or identity embedding is permitted for pair linkage.
